test_title: PYST 41: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 2nd November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully, Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All burgers are cakes.

Some sweets are fruits.

All sweets are burgers.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some fruits are burgers.

II. Some cakes are sweets.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a1563f797d3eed4780a5c8b36d119fc45ac854b5d4078bacd95b0e10cc5c413.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some fruits are burgers → Follow (As some sweets are fruits, all sweets are burgers. So, it is definitely true)

II. Some cakes are sweets → **F**ollow (As all burgers are cakes, all sweets are burgers. So, it is definitely true)

∴ Here, Both the conclusions follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Both the conclusions follow**".
